 --> Bigg Boss 20: Rohit Shetty schools ScoutOP over massaging Lovepreet Kaur Gill under blanket, says 'It is not looking good at all'
 Rohit Shetty will host this week’s Bigg Boss 20 Weekend Ka Vaar in Salman Khan’s absence. A new promo shows him questioning ScoutOP and Lovepreet Kaur Gill about their closeness. 
 Gayatri Rani 
 October 24, 2026 / 11:07 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 Rohit Shetty to host Bigg Boss new episode 
 Filmmaker Rohit Shetty will host this week’s Bigg Boss 20 Weekend Ka Vaar instead of Salman Khan.
 During the October 18 episode, Salman announced that he would be absent due to prior professional commitments and revealed that the filmmaker would host the upcoming episode instead.
 The makers have now dropped a new promo and created a buzz among the fans. In the promo, Rohit confronts contestants ScoutOP and Lovepreet Kaur Gill about their physical closeness inside the house.
 Rohit Shetty questions their interactions, especially the moments when Scout massages Love under a blanket, and tells them that their conduct is not being perceived positively on screen. Known for his straightforward approach on reality television, Rohit openly addresses the matter, paving the way for a tense Weekend Ka Vaar.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by JioHotstar Reality (@jiohotstarreality) 
 Related Stories
 Jay Bhanushali reacts to Mahhi Vij's alimony revelation, says 'Money was never between us and never ... 
 Bigg Boss 20 contestant Aasif Khan suffered massive heart attack at 34, wife alleges threats after Q... 
 The filmmaker asked, “Love, Scout aapke liye kya hai?" Lovepreet Kaur Gill shared that she considers ScoutOP a brother.
 Rohit replied, “Jab voh pair daba raha hai, haath daba raha hai, neck daba raha hai. Love, voh theek nahi lag raha hai. Aap Scout ko bolte ho peeche se daba de, voh aapke calves daba raha hai. It is not looking good at all (He’s massaging your feet, your hands, your neck—honestly, it just doesn’t look right. You ask Scout to massage you from behind, and he ends up massaging your calves. It doesn’t look good at all).”
 Also Read:  Bigg Boss 20 contestant Aasif Khan suffered massive heart attack at 34, wife alleges threats after Qazi Touqeer’s health remark 
 Scout justified his actions by noting that he also massages Mahhi Vij whenever she asks him to. However, Rohit Shetty scolded him, warning that his interactions with Lovepreet were giving viewers an unfavourable impression.
 Meanwhile, the upcoming Bigg Boss 20 Weekend Ka Vaar episode is going to be more dramatic as ScoutOP’s girlfriend, Kaashvi Hiranandani, is also expected to appear in the episode. She will discuss his increasing closeness with Love inside the house, even though he is in a relationship with her.
 Gayatri Rani is a Senior-Sub Editor with over three years of experience in delivering Hollywood and Bollywood news.
